name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold explorer focused on the Lapon Canyon Project, located within the Walker Lane gold trend in Nevada approximately 40 miles southeast of Yerington. The company holds a 50% exploration earn-in and a 3% net smelter royalty on the project, which targets deeper intrusive-related gold deposits. Nevada Canyon is in the exploration stage and is working toward its first NI 43-101 compliant resource estimate in 2026.
